{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f'Removed {len(qa_orders)} QA orders with revenue = 999,999.99')

# Drop these rows from the dataset
df_clean = df.drop(qa_orders.index)

# Filter to only 'completed' orders
completed_orders = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending and get the highest
highest_segment = conversion_rates['conversion_rate'].idxmax()

# Output the result
print(f'Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}')
print('\nConversion rates by segment:')
print(conversion_rates[['conversion_rate']].round(4))"}
